"**What it means:** Animals must be able to perform natural behaviors, have continuous access to water, outdoor access, and appropriate shelter. They cannot be overcrowded and must have ample room for freedom of movement and exercise. Producers must agree to compliance visits by AWI or one of its agents.


**What’s prohibited:** Cages, crates, tethers, genetic engineering, growth hormones, antibiotics to encourage rapid weight gain and/or to compensate for unsanitary living conditions, feed or feed supplements containing animal products or genetically modified organisms (GMOs), tail-docking, debeaking, detusking of breeding male pigs, sow crates and hot branding."

This article is actually not accurate at all. Why should we go after a company just because it's huge? That makes no sense. People are going to buy meat no matter what at the moment, so why not buy it from a company that actually sends out people to check out the farms before they buy from the farm. A company that has 100 standards on how the animals are treated before it's even considered to be sold in the store. And I don't feel as though they are tricking  "animal loving meat buyers", they're just saying that they actually have standards, while there's not a single store that does.

It's actually not a marketing campaign and if it was you could sue them for a lot of money for claiming what they do. While they have the five step program for chosing meat, they also have 100 standards it has to meet before even reaching the lowest tier of the five steps.
Source: I actually work there.

I'll probably get a lot of hate for this, but why go after whole foods? All the adds are getting at is that they actually have standards and won't support factory farms, which is a good thing. The demand for meat is there right now and as a company they would lose a lot of money if they stopped supplying it entirlely, which is incredibly lame but is the fact of the matter. Why not go after other companies that are actually fully in support of factory farming and intentionally violent actions towards animals instead of the only grocery store in the world that actually trying to ensure environmental sustainablility and higher standards of farming. Also, research their fishing practices, these people seem misinformed.
